generalAbilities.name: Site Bound
generalAbilities.description:
The Shadefield spirit is bound to the Shadefields.

A typical ghost can stray only a short distance from where it was killed or the place it haunts. A typical limit is 120 feet. Some ghosts are instead bound to a room, building, item, or creature that was special to it rather than a location.

defensiveAbilities.name: Rejuvenation
defensiveAbilities.description:
Putting Diskah Night Watcher's spirit to rest allows the Shadefield spirit to return to its original role as a guardian haunt.

When a ghost is destroyed, it re-forms after 2d4 days within the location it's bound to, fully healed. A ghost can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Cindery Assault
offensiveAbilities.description: The Shadefield spirit cries out in pain and anguish as flaming objects and debris fly about in a 30ft Type:emanation. Creatures in this area take 3d6 Bludgeoning Damage|options:area-damage]{3d6 bludgeoning damage plus 1d6 persistent fire damage} (Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Corrupting Gaze
offensiveAbilities.description: The Shadefield spirit stares at a creature it can see within 30 feet. The target takes 3d6 Void Damage damage (Basic DC 20 Will Saving Throw save). A creature that fails its save is also Stupefied 1 for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sworn to the Storm
offensiveAbilities.description: The Shadefield spirit gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attacks against creatures that have attempted to Disable the Shoanti ancestor storm.
